Feel_Lead.Text: Adjust how thrown windows move. Natural frequency and damping ratio control speed and return. A preset sets all four values except snap radius. Changing a value makes it custom.
Feel_CurveLegend.Text: Curve: position after moving one zone with a key (time runs left to right; the dashed line is the target).
Feel_CurveThrowNote.Text: The same natural frequency and damping ratio also shape the speed and return of a throw.
Feel_TrialCard.AutomationName: Trial window. Throw by dragging the title bar or using arrow keys.
Feel_TrialHint.Text: Throw using the title bar; dragging inside won't move it. The five current values and Snapwell's target rules apply. Below 150 px/s, it won't snap. In Cells mode, throw upward from the center to maximize.
Feel_MassDescription.Text: The reference value for stiffness k and damping c. With the same natural frequency and damping ratio, increasing mass increases the displayed k and c.
Feel_FrequencyDescription.Text: Controls speed with key actions, attraction from a distance, and slowing after a throw.
Feel_MagnetDescription.Text: Strength of attraction near the resting point, inside the snap radius. Attraction from a distance stays the same (0–2).
Feel_MotionDescription.Text: Move straight to the snap target without animation. Also applies when Windows Animation effects are off.
Feel_ResizeTimingDescription.Text: Changing size while moving may cause rendering glitches in some windows.
